svg.title: Glove mechanical concept, dorsal view
svg.desc: Right hand from the back: dorsal plate with three XL330 servos, tendons through an MCP guide bar and guide rings to fingertip thimbles, thumb tendon in a Bowden tube to a thumb MCP cuff, Vive tracker on wrist cuff, ESP32 module and kill switch on forearm.

g.text: Guide rings, dorsal side of phalanges
Dorsal plate, printed, curved to hand
